question: What will be the closing value of the euro to US dollar exchange rate (EURUSD=X on Yahoo Finance) on October 2, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of EURUSD=X on Yahoo Finance for 2026-10-02. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
I could only use search results for this. Every direct page fetch was refused by the proxy, including Yahoo Finance itself. Many results were dated after 2026-09-04, and I left all of them out.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Yahoo Finance daily close of EURUSD=X for 2026-10-02, a Friday. That is a normal trading day, so the weekend fallback should not apply. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/EURUSD=X/history/)
- I could not read the Yahoo history page because the proxy refused the connection, so I have no Yahoo close for 2026-09-04. Yahoo's FX "close" is a snapshot of a market that trades around the clock, so it can differ slightly from ECB or Investing.com figures.
- 2026-09-04: RoboForex put EUR/USD near 1.1625 ahead of the US jobs report, with a bullish bias and a 1.1700 target. [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/currencies/eur-usd-forecast-2026-09-04/)
- 2026-09-03: A converter site lists 1.1629. RoboForex had the pair at about 1.1603, with support at 1.1565 and a target of 1.1715. [currency-converter](https://www.currency-converter.org.uk/currency-rates/historical/table/EUR-USD.html), [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/currencies/eur-usd-forecast-2026-09-03/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Spot was about 1.16 on 2026-09-04, in the upper-middle part of the question's 1.10 to 1.20 range.
- 2026-09-04: US August payrolls rose 162k against a 53k consensus, and unemployment held at 4.1%. Treasury yields jumped, the dollar firmed and traders raised bets on a Fed hike in September. A JustMarkets release put the dollar index up about 0.2%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/04/jobs-report-august-2026.html), [moomoo](https://www.moomoo.com/community/feed/u-s-august-nonfarm-payrolls-how-a-strong-reading-turned-117227415470085)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-04: A StoneX technical note says the pair held key support for a second straight week after pulling back from its August highs. It lists resistance at 1.1679 and at 1.1746/75 (key), and support at 1.1564/78, then 1.1472. [StoneX](https://www.stonex.com/en-gb/news-and-analysis/euro-technical-forecast-eur-usd-holds-the-line-as-september-battle-takes-shape-9-4-2026-2026-09-04/)
- 2026-09-03: ADP private payrolls rose only 38k in August, which lifted the euro to about 1.160. [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/currencies/eur-usd-forecast-2026-09-03/)
- Early September: All 65 economists in a Reuters poll expect the ECB to raise its deposit rate 25bp to 2.50% on 2026-09-10. [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/currencies/eur-usd-forecast-2026-09-04/)
- 2026-08-31: An options note put spot at 1.1586. [mql5](https://www.mql5.com/ja/blogs/post/775093)
- 2026-08-14: FXStreet said hawkish ECB prospects were supporting the euro near 1.155. [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/eur-usd-price-forecast-hawkish-ecb-prospects-support-euro-202608140754)
- 2026-08-04: GMO-Aozora reported a July 31 close of 1.15386, up about 1.03% in July. The Fed held at 3.50 to 3.75% in a 9 to 3 vote, with three dissenters wanting a hike. The ECB deposit rate was 2.25%. [GMO-Aozora](https://gmo-aozora.com/fx/report/pdf/EUR_USD_202608.pdf)
- 2026-08-03: RoboForex had the pair at 1.1530 and said the market-implied chance of a September hike had fallen from 80% to 64%. It was not clear from the snippet which central bank that referred to. [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/ph/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/currencies/eur-usd-forecast-2026-08-03/)
- 2026-07-27: UOB said the outlook for an ECB hike in September was supporting the euro. [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/euro-september-hike-outlook-offers-support-against-us-dollar-uob-202607270613)

## 4. Base rates
- Recent levels:
  - 2026-07-31: 1.1539
  - 2026-08-20: 1.1683, roughly the August high
  - 2026-08-28: 1.1585
  - 2026-08-31: 1.1586
  - 2026-09-04: about 1.1625
  
  [valutafx 08-20](https://www.valutafx.com/history/eur-usd-2026-08-20), [valutafx 08-28](https://www.valutafx.com/history/eur-usd-2026-08-28)
- Trend: a gentle rise, with July up about 1% and August up about 0.4% (my calculation). The pair stayed in a 1.15 to 1.17 band from July through early September.
- Typical variation (my own estimate, not from a source): EUR/USD implied volatility usually runs about 6 to 8% a year. Over the roughly 20 trading days to resolution, that gives a one-standard-deviation move of about 1.7 to 2.3%, or about ±2 to 2.7 cents from 1.16.
  - Going below 1.10 would take a drop of about 5%, roughly 2 to 3 standard deviations.
  - Going above 1.20 would take a rise of about 3.3%, roughly 1.5 to 2 standard deviations.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Kalshi, Polymarket or Manifold market for the 2026-10-02 close. Robinhood lists daily EUR/USD contracts, for example one for 2026-09-03. [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/fx/events/euro-to-us-dollar-exchange-rate-september-3-2026-sep-03-2026/)
- Polymarket's "Will EUR/USD hit __ in 2026" touch contracts (snapshot dated 2026-05-03, now stale, zero 24h volume): 1.20 at 72¢, 1.12 at 50¢, 1.00 at 5¢. These pay out if the level is touched at any time before year-end, not on a close at a set date. [simplefunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/odds/eurusd-hit)
- An earlier J.P. Morgan forecast put EUR/USD at 1.15 in September; I could not confirm its date. [JPM](https://www.jpmorgan.com/insights/global-research/currencies/currency-volatility-dollar-strength)
- Cambridge Currencies projected a range of about 1.13 to 1.17 over one to three months. I could not confirm the page's date because it carries post-cutoff edits, so treat this lightly. [Cambridge](https://cambridgecurrencies.com/euro-to-dollar-forecast/)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
Dates are standard calendar estimates unless a source is linked.
- 2026-09-10: ECB decision. A 25bp hike to 2.50% is essentially fully priced, so guidance is likely to matter more than the move itself. [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/analysis/a-key-week-for-eur-usd-ecb-decision-and-us-inflation-in-focus-202609080646)
- About 2026-09-10/11: US August CPI.
- 2026-09-15/16: FOMC meeting. After the strong jobs report there is live risk of the first Fed hike since 2023, and a new dot plot will be published.
- Late September: US PCE inflation, euro-area PMIs and German Ifo.
- About 2026-10-01: Euro-area flash September inflation (HICP).
- 2026-10-02: US September jobs report at 12:30 UTC, released on the resolution day itself, before the Yahoo close.
- Background risks: French fiscal and political stress, and broader risk-off moves in markets.
